Class ViewModel

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.client.view.ViewModel
public class ViewModel extends Object
Representation Client-side of the Model.
This Class represents the Model Client-side: it is a simplified version formed by different collections of objects representing the Game current State.
It is used both for move validity checks by the VirtualView Class, both by the user interface for drawing the Game current State.
